dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the symbol deciphering coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Ah, ahoy there, Traveler! Welcome aboard the Alcor!

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: It's been quite tough, I won't lie, but it's gone well enough. We've obtained quite a lot of nautical maps from various sources, so a full deciphering will take some time yet.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I've heard that you're quite the code-breaker and puzzle-solver yourself. If I had your help, this would probably be much easier...

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: ...Well, when you're free, of course! Also, feel free to tell me if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: What a headache. What do those symbols that the previous navigator drew mean? Are those areas where they encountered leviathans?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with the long face?

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I'm the crew's navigator. Determining our heading and course is my charge, as is drawing up nautical charts.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Our previous navigator was getting on in years, so I came to take his spot.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: He loved employing some unique symbols to mark his nautical maps, but he never bothered to explain the meaning behind them...

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: ...But I suppose that might be a quirk endemic to navigators.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I mean, it's quick and easy, if troublesome for anyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about those leviathans?

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I've been fascinated by marine biology since I was a child. Especially those behemoths hidden deep beneath the waves...

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: To be honest, I signed up for this job precisely because I'd heard that Captain Beidou slew Haishan.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: More's the pity that I haven't had the chance to see a leviathan with my own eyes. I'd really love to see one up close some day.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I've also heard some sailors say that they saw something like giant antennae around the Sea of Clouds...

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: ...Is that true or not? Who knows. Perhaps they were just seeing things while dead drunk.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, see you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: I swear I'll become a navigator who actually does documentation...
